Name: SP_EFFECT_PARAM_ST
Description:
Defines various effects that can be applied to the player and to enemies.
Can define passive, activated, single-use and repeated or continuous application effects with indefinite duration.
Successful application may depend on spCategory or invocationConditions.

Fields.Name: Icon ID
Fields.Description: Status icon shown while the effect is active. With Display Icon when Inactive, also shown while the effect waits for its trigger condition. -1: no icon.

Fields.Name: Trigger Condition: HP At or Below %
Fields.Description: The effect only works while the character's HP is at or below this percentage of max HP. It is re-checked continuously: outside the condition the effect waits (inactive), or is removed with Delete When Waiting. -1: no condition.

Fields.Name: Duration
Fields.Description: Duration in seconds. -1: permanent. 0: lasts a single frame (one trigger). The time can be scaled when the effect is applied (Duration Rate for Target State) and while it runs (duration extension/shortening flags).

Fields.Name: Trigger Interval
Fields.Description: Seconds between triggers. The effect triggers as soon as it becomes active, then every interval; 0 triggers every frame. Per-trigger values (HP/FP/stamina change, Runes Granted, Cycle SpEffect ID, durability change, online requests) apply on each trigger. State Info 50, 52, 67 and 68 wait one interval before the first trigger.

Fields.Name: Max HP %
Fields.Description: Multiplier on max HP. Values from every active effect multiply; 0 or less is ignored. With Is NG+ Scaling, also scaled by the NG+ cycle's correction.

Fields.Name: Max FP %
Fields.Description: Multiplier on max FP. Values from every active effect multiply; 0 or less is ignored. With Is NG+ Scaling, also scaled by the NG+ cycle's correction.

Fields.Name: Max Stamina %
Fields.Description: Multiplier on max stamina. Values from every active effect multiply; 0 or less is ignored. With Is NG+ Scaling, also scaled by the NG+ cycle's correction.

Fields.Name: Damage Taken %: Slash
Fields.Description: Multiplier on slash damage the character takes (1.2: +20%, 0: none). Values from every active effect multiply. Only applies to hits on the body part set by Apply to Body Part Group.

Fields.Name: Damage Taken %: Strike
Fields.Description: Multiplier on strike damage the character takes (1.2: +20%, 0: none). Values from every active effect multiply. Only applies to hits on the body part set by Apply to Body Part Group.

Fields.Name: Damage Taken %: Pierce
Fields.Description: Multiplier on pierce damage the character takes (1.2: +20%, 0: none). Values from every active effect multiply. Only applies to hits on the body part set by Apply to Body Part Group.

Fields.Name: Damage Taken %: Standard
Fields.Description: Multiplier on standard physical damage the character takes (1.2: +20%, 0: none). Values from every active effect multiply. Only applies to hits on the body part set by Apply to Body Part Group.

Fields.Name: Damage Taken %: Magic
Fields.Description: Multiplier on magic damage the character takes (1.2: +20%, 0: none). Values from every active effect multiply. Only applies to hits on the body part set by Apply to Body Part Group.

Fields.Name: Damage Taken %: Fire
Fields.Description: Multiplier on fire damage the character takes (1.2: +20%, 0: none). Values from every active effect multiply. Only applies to hits on the body part set by Apply to Body Part Group.

Fields.Name: Damage Taken %: Lightning
Fields.Description: Multiplier on lightning damage the character takes (1.2: +20%, 0: none). Values from every active effect multiply. Only applies to hits on the body part set by Apply to Body Part Group.

Fields.Name: Damage Dealt %: Physical
Fields.Description: Multiplier on the physical damage of the character's attacks, applied to the hit after attack power. Values from every active effect multiply; 0 is ignored. Combined with the per-type rate (Slash/Strike/Pierce/Standard) of the attack's physical type. Only effects whose Weapon Parameter Change and attack filters fit the attack count.

Fields.Name: Damage Dealt %: Magic
Fields.Description: Multiplier on the magic damage of the character's attacks, applied to the hit after attack power. Values from every active effect multiply; 0 is ignored. Only effects whose Weapon Parameter Change and attack filters fit the attack count.

Fields.Name: Damage Dealt %: Fire
Fields.Description: Multiplier on the fire damage of the character's attacks, applied to the hit after attack power. Values from every active effect multiply; 0 is ignored. Only effects whose Weapon Parameter Change and attack filters fit the attack count.

Fields.Name: Damage Dealt %: Lightning
Fields.Description: Multiplier on the lightning damage of the character's attacks, applied to the hit after attack power. Values from every active effect multiply; 0 is ignored. Only effects whose Weapon Parameter Change and attack filters fit the attack count.

Fields.Name: Power %: Physical
Fields.Description: Multiplier on the physical attack power of the character's attacks (before defence). Values from every active effect multiply, together with the per-type rate of the attack's physical type. With Is NG+ Scaling, also scaled by the NG+ cycle's correction. Only effects whose attack filters fit the attack count.

Fields.Name: Power %: Magic
Fields.Description: Multiplier on the magic attack power of the character's attacks (before defence). Values from every active effect multiply. With Is NG+ Scaling, also scaled by the NG+ cycle's correction. Only effects whose attack filters fit the attack count.

Fields.Name: Power %: Fire
Fields.Description: Multiplier on the fire attack power of the character's attacks (before defence). Values from every active effect multiply. With Is NG+ Scaling, also scaled by the NG+ cycle's correction. Only effects whose attack filters fit the attack count.

Fields.Name: Power %: Lightning
Fields.Description: Multiplier on the lightning attack power of the character's attacks (before defence). Values from every active effect multiply. With Is NG+ Scaling, also scaled by the NG+ cycle's correction. Only effects whose attack filters fit the attack count.

Fields.Name: Power +: Physical
Fields.Description: Flat physical attack power added to the character's attacks, after the power rates. Values from every active effect add up; negative values are ignored. Scaled by the stat corrections (Use Strength/Dexterity/Intelligence/Faith Correction) and the attack's SpEffect correction.

Fields.Name: Power +: Magic
Fields.Description: Flat magic attack power added to the character's attacks, after the power rates. Values from every active effect add up; negative values are ignored. Scaled by the stat corrections and the attack's SpEffect correction.

Fields.Name: Power +: Fire
Fields.Description: Flat fire attack power added to the character's attacks, after the power rates. Values from every active effect add up; negative values are ignored. Scaled by the stat corrections and the attack's SpEffect correction.

Fields.Name: Power +: Lightning
Fields.Description: Flat lightning attack power added to the character's attacks, after the power rates. Values from every active effect add up; negative values are ignored. Scaled by the stat corrections and the attack's SpEffect correction.

Fields.Name: Defence %: Physical
Fields.Description: Multiplier on the character's physical defence (the defence value, not absorption). Values from every active effect multiply. With Is NG+ Scaling, also scaled by the NG+ cycle's correction.

Fields.Name: Defence %: Magic
Fields.Description: Multiplier on the character's magic defence (the defence value, not absorption). Values from every active effect multiply. With Is NG+ Scaling, also scaled by the NG+ cycle's correction.

Fields.Name: Defence %: Fire
Fields.Description: Multiplier on the character's fire defence (the defence value, not absorption). Values from every active effect multiply. With Is NG+ Scaling, also scaled by the NG+ cycle's correction.

Fields.Name: Defence %: Lightning
Fields.Description: Multiplier on the character's lightning defence (the defence value, not absorption). Values from every active effect multiply. With Is NG+ Scaling, also scaled by the NG+ cycle's correction.

Fields.Name: Defence +: Physical
Fields.Description: Flat physical defence added after the defence rate. Values from every active effect add up; negative values are ignored. Scaled by the stat corrections.

Fields.Name: Defence +: Magic
Fields.Description: Flat magic defence added after the defence rate. Values from every active effect add up; negative values are ignored. Scaled by the stat corrections.

Fields.Name: Defence +: Fire
Fields.Description: Flat fire defence added after the defence rate. Values from every active effect add up; negative values are ignored. Scaled by the stat corrections.

Fields.Name: Defence +: Lightning
Fields.Description: Flat lightning defence added after the defence rate. Values from every active effect add up; negative values are ignored. Scaled by the stat corrections.

Fields.Name: No Guard Damage %
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game.

Fields.Name: Weak Point Damage %
Fields.Description: Damage multiplier used for hits on a weak point of the character. Values of 0 or more from every active effect multiply. -1: no change. No retail row sets it.

Fields.Name: Normal Spot Damage %
Fields.Description: Damage multiplier used for hits that aren't on a weak point. Values of 0 or more from every active effect multiply. -1: no change. No retail row sets it.

Fields.Name: Look-At Target Position Offset
Fields.Description: Height offset (m) of the point other characters look at and aim for on this character. Values from every active effect add up. Retail: crouching and mounted states.

Fields.Name: Behavior ID
Fields.Description:
Specified -1 when dealing damage using action ID from special effects
NPC Behavior - Requires State Info 142
Player Behavior - Requires State Info 275
Bullet Behavior - Requires State Info 33

Fields.Name: HP Change % per Trigger
Fields.Description: Percentage of max HP lost on each trigger; negative values heal. Scaled by the stat corrections. Damage is multiplied by the ailment damage rates for blood loss, frostbite, sleep and madness effects; healing is multiplied by HP Recovery Effectiveness %. Values from all effects triggering in the same frame add up.

Fields.Name: HP Change per Trigger
Fields.Description: HP lost on each trigger; negative values heal. Scaled and combined like HP Change % per Trigger.

Fields.Name: FP Change % per Trigger
Fields.Description: Percentage of max FP lost on each trigger; negative values restore FP. Values from all effects triggering in the same frame add up.

Fields.Name: FP Change per Trigger
Fields.Description: FP lost on each trigger; negative values restore FP. Values from all effects triggering in the same frame add up.

Fields.Name: FP Recovery Speed
Fields.Description: Added to the FP recovery speed. Values from every active effect add up. No retail row sets it.

Fields.Name: Stamina Change % per Trigger
Fields.Description: Percentage of max stamina lost on each trigger; negative values restore stamina. Values from all effects triggering in the same frame add up.

Fields.Name: Stamina Change per Trigger
Fields.Description: Stamina lost on each trigger; negative values restore stamina. Values from all effects triggering in the same frame add up.

Fields.Name: Stamina Recovery Speed
Fields.Description: Added to the stamina recovery speed. Values from every active effect add up.

Fields.Name: Magic Effect Time Change
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game.

Fields.Name: Current Durability +
Fields.Description: Durability change applied on each trigger by effects with a durability State Info (4: spoil, 26, 146, 292). Values add up. State 4 is skipped when Ignore Durability Loss is set on the row.

Fields.Name: Max Durability
Fields.Description: Added to max durability on each trigger. Values add up. No retail row sets it.

Fields.Name: Damage Dealt %: Stamina
Fields.Description: Multiplier on the stamina damage of the character's attacks. Values from every active effect multiply. With Is NG+ Scaling, also scaled by the NG+ cycle's correction.

Fields.Name: Aux Inflict +: Poison
Fields.Description: Poison build-up added to the character when an effect with State Info 2 (poison) is applied; negative values reduce it (-99999 clears it). Scaled by the application and by the character's poison resistance rate. Blocked by Disable Poison.

Fields.Name: Aux Inflict +: Scarlet Rot
Fields.Description: Scarlet rot build-up added to the character when an effect with State Info 5 (scarlet rot) is applied; negative values reduce it (-99999 clears it). Scaled by the application and by the character's rot resistance rate. Blocked by Disable Scarlet Rot.

Fields.Name: Aux Inflict +: Blood Loss
Fields.Description: Blood loss build-up added to the character when an effect with State Info 6 (blood loss) is applied; negative values reduce it (-99999 clears it). Scaled by the application and by the character's blood loss resistance rate. Blocked by Disable Blood Loss.

Fields.Name: Aux Inflict +: Death Blight
Fields.Description: Death blight build-up added to the character when an effect with State Info 116 (death blight) is applied; negative values reduce it (-99999 clears it). Scaled by the application and by the character's death blight resistance rate. Blocked by Disable Death Blight.

Fields.Name: Fall Damage %
Fields.Description: Multiplier on fall damage. Values from every active effect multiply; 0: no fall damage.

Fields.Name: Rune Gain %
Fields.Description: Multiplier on runes the player gains. Values from every active effect multiply.

Fields.Name: Max Equip Load %
Fields.Description: Multiplier on max equip load. Values above 0 from every active effect multiply.

Fields.Name: Item Weight %
Fields.Description: Multiplier on the total item weight limit. Values above 0 from every active effect multiply. No retail row sets a value other than 1.

Fields.Name: Runes Granted per Trigger
Fields.Description: Runes given to the player on each trigger. Values from all effects triggering in the same frame add up.

Fields.Name: Anim ID Offset
Fields.Description: Added to the character's animation IDs (1000000: use the +1000000 animation set). Values of 0 or more from every active effect add up. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Rune Drop %
Fields.Description: Multiplier on the runes the character awards when killed. Values from every active effect multiply. With Is NG+ Scaling, also scaled by the NG+ cycle's correction.

Fields.Name: Target Priority
Fields.Description: Added to this character's priority as an AI target. Values from every active effect add up. Retail uses -1 to 10.

Fields.Name: Enemy Sight Detection %
Fields.Description: Multiplier on how easily enemy AI spots this character by sight, used with the matching additive field. Values from every active effect multiply; 0 or less is also flagged to the AI. Effects with State Info 7 or 53 only count in some checks.

Fields.Name: Enemy Hearing Detection %
Fields.Description: Multiplier on how easily enemy AI hears this character. Values from every active effect multiply; the result is clamped to 0–99. Effects with State Info 7 or 53 only count in some checks.

Fields.Name: Gravity %
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game.

Fields.Name: Aux Resist %: Poison
Fields.Description: Multiplier on poison resistance. Values of 0 or more from every active effect multiply. With Is NG+ Scaling, also scaled by the NG+ cycle's correction.

Fields.Name: Aux Resist %: Scarlet Rot
Fields.Description: Multiplier on scarlet rot resistance. Values of 0 or more from every active effect multiply. With Is NG+ Scaling, also scaled by the NG+ cycle's correction.

Fields.Name: Aux Resist %: Blood Loss
Fields.Description: Multiplier on blood loss resistance. Values of 0 or more from every active effect multiply. With Is NG+ Scaling, also scaled by the NG+ cycle's correction.

Fields.Name: Aux Resist %: Death Blight
Fields.Description: Multiplier on death blight resistance. Values of 0 or more from every active effect multiply. With Is NG+ Scaling, also scaled by the NG+ cycle's correction.

Fields.Name: Soul Steal Damage %
Fields.Description: Multiplier on the HP loss of effects with State Info 14 (soul steal) on this character. Values from every active effect multiply. If the product is 0, the character awards no runes when killed. Retail: always 1 on used rows.

Fields.Name: Duration Rate for Target State
Fields.Description: When another effect whose State Info matches Duration Rate - Target State Info is applied to the character, its duration is multiplied by this value. Several active effects multiply.

Fields.Name: HP Recovery Effectiveness %
Fields.Description: Multiplier on HP healed by SpEffects (negative HP change). Values from every active effect multiply.

Fields.Name: Chain SpEffect ID
Fields.Description: SpEffect applied to the character when this effect ends by running out. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Cycle SpEffect ID
Fields.Description: SpEffect applied to the character on each trigger (see Trigger Interval). -1: none.

Fields.Name: Attack SpEffect ID
Fields.Description: SpEffect used when the character's attack hits, read from the first active effect with State Info 152 or 153 that fits the attack (Weapon Parameter Change and attack filters). -1: none. Retail: weapon enchant buffs.

Fields.Name: Guard Defense - Weapon Repel Power %
Fields.Description: Multiplier on the player's repel (deflect) strength while guarding. Only counts on effects with State Info 158 or 204; values multiply.

Fields.Name: Guard Stability %
Fields.Description: Multiplier in the player's guard stamina damage calculation. Only counts on effects with State Info 158 or 204, and on State Info 470 effects in PvP; values multiply.

Fields.Name: Raycast Passed Time
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game.

Fields.Name: Conditional Category [1]
Fields.Description: Limits the effect's attack modifiers to attacks with this sub-category. With several of the three sub-category fields set, an attack matching any of them counts. 0: all attacks.

Fields.Name: Conditional Category [2]
Fields.Description: Limits the effect's attack modifiers to attacks with this sub-category. With several of the three sub-category fields set, an attack matching any of them counts. 0: all attacks.

Fields.Name: Bow Distance %
Fields.Description: Bow range bonus in percent (65: +65%). Values from every active effect add up; the total is clamped to -100–999.

Fields.Name: Effect Category
Fields.Description: How the effect stacks with effects already on the character. 0 (and unlisted values): different IDs stack, re-applying the same ID while active is refused. 10: every application stacks. 20: re-applying the same ID refreshes it. 100, 200, 201: one per category and priority. 110, 130–180: one per category, the newest replaces. 1003–1006: one per category, a lower or equal Category Priority replaces, a higher one is refused. 1000, 1002: all stay, only the lowest Category Priority is active. 1001: supplies the damage level remap. 10000–10010: the first applied wins (ailments).

Fields.Name: Category Priority
Fields.Description: Priority within the Effect Category; a lower number wins.

Fields.Name: Save Category
Fields.Description: -1: the effect is removed at death. Any other value keeps it through death and stores it in the player's saved effects (10 is never stored). Retail: the ailment rows.

Fields.Name: Magic Attunement Slot
Fields.Description: Extra memory slots. Values from every active effect add up. Retail: Moon of Nokstella (2).

Fields.Name: Miracle Attunement Slot
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game.

Fields.Name: Humanity Damage
Fields.Description: Added to a player counter on each trigger; values add up. What the counter does is not established.

Fields.Name: Weapon Repel Defence +
Fields.Description: Repel (deflect) strength of the character against incoming attacks. The highest value among active effects is used when above the character's own.

Fields.Name: Repel Damage Reduction %
Fields.Description: Damage reduction (%) used when the character repels an attack. The highest value among active effects counts.

Fields.Name: Damage Correction %: Blood Loss
Fields.Description: Percentage applied to the HP damage of blood loss effects (State Info 6) on this character (100: normal). With Is NG+ Scaling, also scaled by the NG+ cycle's correction.

Fields.Name: Damage Level: No Impact
Fields.Description: Damage level used instead when the character is hit with the None level. Taken from the active effect with Effect Category 1001 and the lowest Category Priority. 0: keep the attack's level.

Fields.Name: Damage Level: Small Impact
Fields.Description: Damage level used instead when the character is hit with the Small level. Taken from the active effect with Effect Category 1001 and the lowest Category Priority. 0: keep the attack's level.

Fields.Name: Damage Level: Medium Impact
Fields.Description: Damage level used instead when the character is hit with the Medium level. Taken from the active effect with Effect Category 1001 and the lowest Category Priority. 0: keep the attack's level.

Fields.Name: Damage Level: Large Impact
Fields.Description: Damage level used instead when the character is hit with the Large level. Taken from the active effect with Effect Category 1001 and the lowest Category Priority. 0: keep the attack's level.

Fields.Name: Damage Level: Medium Blow
Fields.Description: Damage level used instead when the character is hit with the Medium Blow level. Taken from the active effect with Effect Category 1001 and the lowest Category Priority. 0: keep the attack's level.

Fields.Name: Damage Level: Push
Fields.Description: Damage level used instead when the character is hit with the Push level. Taken from the active effect with Effect Category 1001 and the lowest Category Priority. 0: keep the attack's level.

Fields.Name: Damage Level: Strike
Fields.Description: Damage level used instead when the character is hit with the Strike level. Taken from the active effect with Effect Category 1001 and the lowest Category Priority. 0: keep the attack's level.

Fields.Name: Damage Level: Small Blow
Fields.Description: Damage level used instead when the character is hit with the Small Blow level. Taken from the active effect with Effect Category 1001 and the lowest Category Priority. 0: keep the attack's level.

Fields.Name: Damage Level: Minimal
Fields.Description: Damage level used instead when the character is hit with the Minimal level. Taken from the active effect with Effect Category 1001 and the lowest Category Priority. 0: keep the attack's level.

Fields.Name: Damage Level: Uppercut
Fields.Description: Damage level used instead when the character is hit with the Uppercut level. Taken from the active effect with Effect Category 1001 and the lowest Category Priority. 0: keep the attack's level.

Fields.Name: Damage Level: Blow Backward
Fields.Description: Damage level used instead when the character is hit with the Blow Backward level. Taken from the active effect with Effect Category 1001 and the lowest Category Priority. 0: keep the attack's level.

Fields.Name: Damage Level: Breath
Fields.Description: Damage level used instead when the character is hit with the Breath level. Taken from the active effect with Effect Category 1001 and the lowest Category Priority. 0: keep the attack's level.

Fields.Name: Attack Attribute
Fields.Description: Physical attributes to set for special effects

Fields.Name: SpEffect Attribute
Fields.Description: Special attributes to set for special effects

Fields.Name: State Info
Fields.Description: Built-in behaviour of the effect, also tested by TAE, EMEVD, HKS and AI scripts. 0: none.

Fields.Name: Weapon Parameter Change
Fields.Description: Which of the character's attacks the effect's attack modifiers apply to. 0: all. 1: right-hand weapon attacks. 2: left-hand weapon attacks. 3: no weapon attack. 4: kicks only. 5 and 6: like 0, but ended when the right (5) or left (6) weapon is changed; 1 and 2 also end then. Sorcery, incantation and pyromancy attacks use Affects Sorcery/Incantation/Pyromancy instead.

Fields.Name: Move Type
Fields.Description: Movement type override. 3, 4 and 5 replace the character's movement type (the first matching active effect wins); other non-zero values are reported to the behaviour scripts. 0: none.

Fields.Name: Duration Rate - Target State Info
Fields.Description: State Info of the effects whose duration Duration Rate for Target State changes when they are applied. 0: none. No retail row sets it.

Fields.Name: Throw Trigger
Fields.Description: Throw condition given to the character while active; the throw code tests for specific values (1, 2, 3, 10 among them) to allow or block throws. 0: none.

Fields.Name: Add Behavior Judge ID - Trigger
Fields.Description: Enemies only: condition (0–9) under which Add Behavior Judge ID - Value is added to the enemy's behaviour judge ID. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Damage Correction %: Frostbite
Fields.Description: Percentage applied to the HP damage of frostbite effects (State Info 260) on this character (100: normal). Also used for the HP damage of sleep effects (State Info 436). With Is NG+ Scaling, also scaled by the NG+ cycle's correction.

Fields.Name: Target Self
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game. Retail sets it widely; who an effect applies to is decided by the Applier Relation flags (Hostile/Friendly/Self) instead.

Fields.Name: Target Friend
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game. Retail sets it widely; who an effect applies to is decided by the Applier Relation flags (Hostile/Friendly/Self) instead.

Fields.Name: Target Enemy
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game. Retail sets it widely; who an effect applies to is decided by the Applier Relation flags (Hostile/Friendly/Self) instead.

Fields.Name: Target Player
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game. Retail sets it widely; who an effect applies to is decided by the Applier Relation flags (Hostile/Friendly/Self) instead.

Fields.Name: Target AI
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game. Retail sets it widely; who an effect applies to is decided by the Applier Relation flags (Hostile/Friendly/Self) instead.

Fields.Name: Target Live
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game. Retail sets it widely; who an effect applies to is decided by the Applier Relation flags (Hostile/Friendly/Self) instead.

Fields.Name: Target Ghost
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game. Retail sets it widely; who an effect applies to is decided by the Applier Relation flags (Hostile/Friendly/Self) instead.

Fields.Name: Disable Sleep
Fields.Description: While active, sleep build-up from applied effects is blocked.

Fields.Name: Disable Madness
Fields.Description: While active, madness build-up from applied effects is blocked.

Fields.Name: Target Attacker
Fields.Description: When the effect comes with an attack's hit, it is applied to the attacker instead of the character hit.

Fields.Name: Display Icon when Inactive
Fields.Description: Shows the status icon even while the effect waits for its trigger condition.

Fields.Name: Generate HP Regain Gauge
Fields.Description: HP lost to this effect's HP change goes into the HP regain (rally) gauge, so it can be won back by attacking.

Fields.Name: Use Intelligence Correction
Fields.Description: Scales the effect's HP change and flat attack/defence values by an Intelligence-based factor supplied when the effect is applied.

Fields.Name: Use Faith Correction
Fields.Description: Scales the effect's HP change and flat attack/defence values by a Faith-based factor supplied when the effect is applied.

Fields.Name: Is NG+ Scaling
Fields.Description: Multiplies the effect's max HP/FP/stamina rates, attack power rates, defence rates, stamina attack rate, rune drop rate, resistance rates and ailment damage rates by the matching values of the current NG+ cycle's correction row.

Fields.Name: Affects Sorcery
Fields.Description: The effect's attack modifiers apply to sorcery attacks.

Fields.Name: Affects Incantation
Fields.Description: The effect's attack modifiers apply to incantation attacks.

Fields.Name: Clear Held Runes
Fields.Description: On trigger, the player's held runes are cleared.

Fields.Name: Request: Friendly Phantom Summon
Fields.Description: On trigger, places a cooperator summon sign.

Fields.Name: Request: Hostile Phantom Summon
Fields.Description: On trigger, places a duelist (hostile) summon sign.

Fields.Name: Request: Invasion
Fields.Description: On trigger, starts an invasion attempt.

Fields.Name: Request: Kick
Fields.Description: On trigger, sends a request to dismiss the online session's guests.

Fields.Name: Request: Return to Own World
Fields.Description: On trigger, sends a request to leave the online session (return to own world).

Fields.Name: Request: NPC Invasion
Fields.Description: On trigger, sends an NPC invasion request.

Fields.Name: Is No Dead
Fields.Description: Whether you can be killed? (doesnt work)

Fields.Name: Current HP independent Max HP
Fields.Description: When this effect raises max HP, current HP isn't raised with it.

Fields.Name: Ignore Durability Loss
Fields.Description: Skips this effect's durability loss for State Info 4 (spoil).

Fields.Name: Ignore Vision Reductions
Fields.Description: While active, the character's AI ignores reductions to its sight search.

Fields.Name: Ignore Listen Reductions
Fields.Description: While active, the character's AI ignores reductions to its hearing search.

Fields.Name: Ignore Anti-Magic Effect
Fields.Description: You can use magic even in the anti-magic range

Fields.Name: Ignore Fake Targets
Fields.Description: While active, the character's AI targeting ignores decoy targets.

Fields.Name: Ignore Fake Human Targets
Fields.Description: While active, the character's AI targeting ignores human-type decoy targets.

Fields.Name: Ignore Fake Animal Targets
Fields.Description: While active, the character's AI targeting ignores beast-type decoy targets.

Fields.Name: Ignore Gravity Change
Fields.Description: Gravity effect disabled

Fields.Name: Disable Poison
Fields.Description: While active, poison build-up from applied effects is blocked.

Fields.Name: Disable Scarlet Rot
Fields.Description: While active, scarlet rot build-up from applied effects is blocked.

Fields.Name: Disable Blood Loss
Fields.Description: While active, blood loss build-up from applied effects is blocked.

Fields.Name: Disable Death Blight
Fields.Description: While active, death blight build-up from applied effects is blocked.

Fields.Name: Enable Charm
Fields.Description: If this effect is applied, you will be fascinated.

Fields.Name: Enable Lifetime
Fields.Description: Will the life be extended when the flag is set by TAE?

Fields.Name: Use Strength Correction
Fields.Description: Scales the effect's HP change and flat attack/defence values by a Strength-based factor supplied when the effect is applied.

Fields.Name: Use Dexterity Correction
Fields.Description: Scales the effect's HP change and flat attack/defence values by a Dexterity-based factor supplied when the effect is applied. No retail row sets it.

Fields.Name: Erase on Grace Rest
Fields.Description: The effect is removed when the player rests at a Site of Grace.

Fields.Name: Throw Attack Param Change
Fields.Description: The effect's attack modifiers only apply to throw attacks.

Fields.Name: Request: Leave Arena
Fields.Description: If checked, a request to leave the arena will be issued at the time of activation.

Fields.Name: Has Effect Duration Adjustment Applied
Fields.Description: While an effect with State Info 193 is active, this effect's duration runs slower (divided by 1 + the sum of their Extend Life Rate − 1).

Fields.Name: Has Target
Fields.Description: Do you know the enemy? : [Activation condition] (for evil eye users)

Fields.Name: Cancel on Fire Damage
Fields.Description: When the effect is applied to an AI character, its AI re-plans its current action.

Fields.Name: Trigger for Vow Type [0]
Fields.Description: The effect only works while the character's vow type 0 is allowed; clearing it suspends the effect for that vow type. Default: allowed.

Fields.Name: Trigger for Vow Type [1]
Fields.Description: The effect only works while the character's vow type 1 is allowed; clearing it suspends the effect for that vow type. Default: allowed.

Fields.Name: Trigger for Vow Type [2]
Fields.Description: The effect only works while the character's vow type 2 is allowed; clearing it suspends the effect for that vow type. Default: allowed.

Fields.Name: Trigger for Vow Type [3]
Fields.Description: The effect only works while the character's vow type 3 is allowed; clearing it suspends the effect for that vow type. Default: allowed.

Fields.Name: Trigger for Vow Type [4]

Fields.Name: Applier Relation: Hostile

Fields.Name: Applier Relation: Friendly
Fields.Description: Who can receive the effect, relative to the character applying it: characters whose team is friendly to the applier's. Works with Applier Relation: Hostile and Self.

Fields.Name: Applier Relation: Self

Fields.Name: Torrent Only
Fields.Description: If set, the effect only applies when the target is a player's horse (Torrent). Retail: Torrent's food and healing effects, e.g. Rowa Raisin.

Fields.Name: Dead Player Only
Fields.Description: If set, the effect's activation condition always fails, so it never becomes active (the dead-player state it checks doesn't exist in Elden Ring). Unused in retail.

Fields.Name: Can Duration be Reduced
Fields.Description: If set, the remaining duration runs down faster while a duration-shortening effect (state info 301, using its Contract SpEffect Duration %) is active.

Fields.Name: End When Conditions Fail
Fields.Description: For effects with activation conditions (HP %, Trigger on State Info): if set, the effect ends as soon as its conditions fail. If not set, it stays dormant and becomes active again when the conditions pass.

Fields.Name: Apply through No Damage
Fields.Description: HP damage from effects can't hurt a character that takes no damage (only healing gets through). If set, this effect's HP damage is applied anyway while an effect with state info 324 is active on that character.

Fields.Name: Change Team Type
Fields.Description: Team type the character switches to while the effect is active. -1: no change; values above 71 are ignored.

Fields.Name: Behavior Dummy Poly ID
Fields.Description: Dummy poly for the dummy-poly behaviour states (state info 275, 334, 467): the row's Behavior ID is run from this dummy poly. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Effect VFX [0]
Fields.Description: SpEffectVfxParam row played while the effect is active. 0 or -1: none. All eight VFX slots work the same way.

Fields.Name: Accumulator - Over Value - SpEffect ID
Fields.Description: Accumulator effects (state info 303–312): SpEffect applied when this accumulator's counter reaches Accumulator - Over Value. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Accumulator - Over Value
Fields.Description: Accumulator effects: the over-value SpEffect is applied when the counter is at or above this value. -1: disabled.

Fields.Name: Accumulator - Under Value - SpEffect ID
Fields.Description: Accumulator effects: SpEffect applied when the counter drops below Accumulator - Under Value. -1: none. Unused in retail.

Fields.Name: Accumulator - Under Value
Fields.Description: Accumulator effects: the under-value SpEffect is applied when the counter is below this value. -1: disabled. Unused in retail.

Fields.Name: Accumulator - Increment Value
Fields.Description: Added to the counter of each active accumulator effect (state info 303–312, one counter per state) when this effect is applied. Negative values subtract; the counter doesn't go below 0. Effects with state info 314 add it as a bulk increase.

Fields.Name: Vision - Override Angle X

Fields.Name: Vision - Override Angle Y

Fields.Name: Aux Inflict +: Frostbite
Fields.Description: Frostbite build-up dealt to the character the effect lands on (effects with state info 260). Scaled by the target's frostbite build-up multipliers; blocked while the target has an effect with Disable Frostbite. Negative values reduce the build-up (retail grace rows use -99999).

Fields.Name: Generated AI Sound ID
Fields.Description: Requires state info 419. When the effect is applied, emits this AI sound (AiSoundParam) from the character. 0: none.

Fields.Name: Automatic Foot Effect - SFX ID Offset

Fields.Description: Added to Dexterity only for the casting-speed calculation (summed over active effects). Retail: Radagon Icon, Azur's Glintstone Staff.

Fields.Description: Multiplier on toughness damage the character receives. Multiplied across active effects; limited by Apply Parts Group. 1: no change.

Fields.Name: Damage vs Weakness Type A

Fields.Name: Damage vs Weakness Type B
Fields.Description: Damage multiplier for the character's attacks against targets with weakness type B (NpcParam weakness flags, or an effect with state info 508). Multiplied across active effects. 1: no change. Retail: anti-undead buffs.

Fields.Name: Damage vs Weakness Type C
Fields.Description: Damage multiplier for the character's attacks against targets with weakness type C (NpcParam weakness flags, or an effect with state info 508). Multiplied across active effects. 1: no change. Retail: dragon greases.

Fields.Name: Damage vs Weakness Type D
Fields.Description: Damage multiplier for the character's attacks against targets with weakness type D (NpcParam weakness flags, or an effect with state info 508). Multiplied across active effects. 1: no change.

Fields.Name: Damage vs Weakness Type E

Fields.Name: Damage vs Weakness Type F

Fields.Name: Defence %: Holy

Fields.Description: Flat holy defence added to the character (summed over active effects). Unused in retail.

Fields.Name: Damage Dealt %: Holy

Fields.Name: Power %: Holy

Fields.Name: Power +: Holy
Fields.Description: Flat holy attack power added to the character's attacks (summed over active effects), after the multipliers.

Fields.Name: Full View in Darkness - Radius
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game. Retail sets it on the torch, lantern and Starlight effects.

Fields.Name: Full View in Darkness - Dummy Poly ID
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game. Retail sets it on the torch effects.

Fields.Name: Trigger on HP Above %
Fields.Description: The effect is only active while the character's HP is at or above this percentage of max HP. -1: no condition. Combines with Trigger at HP Below %; both must pass.

Fields.Name: Stamina Consumption %
Fields.Description: Multiplier on the player's stamina costs. Multiplied across active effects. 1: no change.

Fields.Description: The effect's attack modifiers apply to pyromancy attacks (BehaviorParam attack kind 10). No retail attack uses that kind.

Fields.Description: While active, the AI platoon code treats the character as not to be reported when found (any active effect with the flag counts).

Fields.Name: Apply Only Outside Shelter
Fields.Description: If set, the effect isn't applied while the character is sheltered from above (the rain shadow test). Retail: rain wetness effects.

Fields.Name: Add Behavior Judgment ID - Addition Value

Fields.Name: Damage vs Enemies %: Holy

Fields.Name: Damage Correction %: Sleep

Fields.Name: Apply Parts Group

Fields.Name: Clear Target
